document:4:173:0.text:
I've found another journal today!
The Dark Forest of our olden days is truly a sight to behold...
The journal speaks of the everlasting flowers in the forest, and the dappled shadows on the ground as sunlight filters through the canopy.
It breaks my heart thinking about how the Hypogeans destroyed my beautiful homeland!
The Dark Forest was such a wonderful place...
So, I've come to a decision...
Since going home is no longer possible, I'll just recreate a piece of the Dark Forest here!
<align="right">By Feli</align>
document:4:173:0.source_cn:
今天又找到了一份珍贵的手札！
我们旧日生活的薄暮丛林真是太美了……
手札里记载了那里会有永不凋零的花朵，而阳光穿过树叶时会洒下斑驳的光影。
一想到这么美的故乡被恶魔毁了，我的心就好痛！
薄暮丛林明明是那么美好的地方……
所以，我决定了——
既然不能重返故乡，我就试试在这里复现一小片薄暮丛林的景象吧！
<align="right">——斐利尔</align>

Ugh! Some hopping mushroom sprites wrecked my seedlings today!
At this rate, my plants will all be gone in no time!
I must think of a way to protect them.
Got it! I can summon blue capshrooms to guard the forest!
The chant to enter the forest is <style="highlight">"open mushrooms!"</style>
The capshrooms won't give way until they hear that chant.
In that case, they'll be able to keep the hopping mushroom sprites at bay when they show up again!
Hee-hee, I really am a genius.
 <align="right">By Feli</align>

Appendix: I tested the defense line today—the capshrooms looked absolutely adorable standing guard!
My forest is now in safe hands!

啊！今天发现我的幼苗被蹦蹦菇灵咬坏了！
不行不行，这样下去实验植物们会夭折的！
必须想个办法保护它们。
灵光一闪！我可以召唤霜蓝孢菇来保护实验林地！
通关咒语是——<style="highlight">菇菇开门！</style>
没说出咒语时，孢菇们就会一直保护这里。
这样，就算蹦蹦菇灵出现，也只会跟孢菇们缠斗，无暇进来！
嘿嘿，我真是个天才。

Awesome! I made an exciting discovery about the deadvines today!
I thought withered vines would be fragile, yet they proved to be surprisingly resilient.
They are stronger than metal and don't succumb to fire!
I've woven a door with those vines, hoping it will keep my forest safe forever.
But there has to be a way for me to go in and out myself.
What about a special agent?
<align="right">By Feli</align>

<style="highlight">Moon Orchid Dew x2</style>

比金属还要结实，连火焰都烧不坏！

say:0:1421212001:0.male: I have some vials here for everyone.
say:0:1421212001:0.female: I have some vials here for everyone.

say:1:1421212002:0.text: Use them to collect the dew from the moon orchids.
say:1:1421212002:0.source_cn: 请随意使用瓶子收集月光兰的露水。

say:0:1421213001:0.text: Wonderful! These etching irises will satisfy our needs.
say:0:1421213001:0.source_cn: 太好了，盛放的蚀芯花需要的数量不多，这些就足够了。

say:0:1421214001:0.text: We've already collected two vials of moon orchid dew. I think that's enough.
say:0:1421214001:0.source_cn: 两份月光兰的露水，已经收集完了。

say:1:1421215001:0.text: According to Master Feli's notes, two vials of moon orchid dew and a fully bloomed etching iris should be enough...

I thought withered vines would be fragile, yet they proved to be surprisingly resilient.
They are stronger than metal and don't succumb to fire!
I've woven a door with those vines, hoping it will keep my forest safe forever.
But there has to be a way for me to go in and out myself.
What about a special agent?
<align="right">By Feli</align>

document:4:177:0.source_cn:
太神奇了！我今天发现了枯枯藤的秘密！
原本以为枯萎的藤蔓会变得脆弱，但它们反而更坚韧。
比金属还要结实，连火焰都烧不坏！
我用这些藤蔓编织了一道门，它会永远守护我的小林地！
不过，我还是得留个进出的办法。
用一个特殊药剂如何？
<align="right">——斐利尔</align>

say:13:1421215004:0.text: Let's go open the door while the potion is still hot.
say:13:1421215004:0.source_cn: 趁药剂还新鲜，我们去开门吧。

say:0:1421216001:0.text: You have to pour everything on the viney door.
say:0:1421216001:0.source_cn: 看起来，是对准枯枯藤门浇过去。

say:1:1421218001:0.text: Oh, the monarch dragonflies seem lonely. They also have no appetite.
say:1:1421218001:0.source_cn: 啊……大王蜻蜓好像是太寂寞了，所以没有胃口。

say:2:1421218002:1.text: Is it because the dragonflies lost the person they used to spend every day with...?
say:2:1421218002:1.source_cn: 失去了朝夕相处的人，连进食的兴趣都没有了吗？

say:3:1421218003:0.text: We can help them become active again. Monarch dragonflies love to eat tetra fish...
say:3:1421218003:0.source_cn: 没关系，我们可以让它们重新活跃起来。大王蜻蜓爱吃新鲜的...

say:4:1421218004:0.text: So we need to find a fishing spot and catch some tetra fish. However, we can't just feed it to them. We have to play a hunting game with them first.
say:4:1421218004:0.source_cn: 我们得在旁边钓些新鲜的盲泡鱼来。不只是喂食，还要先陪它...

choice_prompt:5:1421218004.text: So we need to find a fishing spot and catch some tetra fish. However, we can't just feed it to them. We have to play a hunting game with them first.
choice_prompt:5:1421218004.source_cn: 我们得在旁边钓些新鲜的小鱼来。不只是喂食，还要先陪它们玩捕食的游戏。

say:6:1421218005:1.text: I'll stay here and try to cheer them up.
say:6:1421218005:1.source_cn: 那我就留在这里，试试能不能让它们开心起来。

say:8:1421218008:1.text: Alright, I have to remember everything Master Feli taught me. I just need to gently approach them...
say:8:1421218008:1.source_cn: 想想斐利尔大人教的……轻轻靠近它们……

narration:9:1421218009:0.text: Liv stays in the forest with the monarch dragonflies while you and Indris go fishing at a pond nearby.
narration:9:1421218009:0.source_cn: 丽芙留在林地里陪伴大王蜻蜓，而你和因度厄则在一旁的池塘...

say:10:1421218010:0.text: It seems Feli taught her well.
say:10:1421218010:0.source_cn: 看来斐利尔把她教得很好。
say:10:1421218010:0.male: It seems Feli taught her well.
say:10:1421218010:0.female: It seems Feli taught her well.

choice_prompt:11:1421218010.text: It seems Feli taught her well.
choice_prompt:11:1421218010.source_cn: 看来斐利尔把她教得很好。
choice_prompt:11:1421218010.male: It seems Feli taught her well.
choice_prompt:11:1421218010.female: It seems Feli taught her well.

say:12:1421218011:1.text: When I first met Feli, he pretended to be a high priest with a serious demeanor...
say:12:1421218011:1.source_cn: 我刚开始认识斐利尔的时候，他故意装出高级祭司的模样，板...
say:12:1421218011:1.male: When I first met Feli, he pretended to be a high priest with a serious demeanor...
say:12:1421218011:1.female: When I first met Feli, he pretended to be a high priest with a serious demeanor...

say:13:1421218012:1.text: He even lowered his voice to sound older.
say:13:1421218012:1.source_cn: 连说话都会刻意压低声音。
say:13:1421218012:1.male: He even lowered his voice to sound older.
say:13:1421218012:1.female: He even lowered his voice to sound older.

say:14:1421218013:1.text: I saw through his facade in a glance. However, he was so earnest in pretending to be serious that it was cute, so I humored him.
say:14:1421218013:1.source_cn: 但我一眼就看穿了。不过，他装得那么认真，又有点可爱，我...
say:14:1421218013:1.male: I saw through his facade in a glance. However, he was so earnest in pretending to be serious that it was cute, so I humored him.
say:14:1421218013:1.female: I saw through his facade in a glance. However, he was so earnest in pretending to be serious that it was cute, so I humored him.

say:15:1421218014:1.text: Now that he's gone, I sometimes think of these random moments that we all had together... the way he was with Liv and how he played with little creatures when he had time...
say:15:1421218014:1.source_cn: 现在他已经不在了，我偶尔会想起这些小事。他教导丽芙的样...
say:15:1421218014:1.male: Now that he's gone, I sometimes think of these random moments that we all had together... the way he was with Liv and how he played with little creatures when he had time...
say:15:1421218014:1.female: Now that he's gone, I sometimes think of these random moments that we all had together... the way he was with Liv and how he played with little creatures when he had time...

say:16:1421218015:1.text: When I look at Liv now, it reminds me of him. Not that they look anything alike, but how they view life.
say:16:1421218015:1.source_cn: 看着丽芙，我恍惚中也会想起来他。他们有一些相像，不是外...
say:16:1421218015:1.male: When I look at Liv now, it reminds me of him. Not that they look anything alike, but how they view life.
say:16:1421218015:1.female: When I look at Liv now, it reminds me of him. Not that they look anything alike, but how they view life.

say:17:1421218016:1.text: Apologies, I've said too much... Oh, I know a small pond nearby. We can find some fish there.
say:17:1421218016:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我说太多了……附近有个小池塘，我们去那里钓鱼吧。
say:17:1421218016:1.male: Apologies, I've said too much... Oh, I know a small pond nearby. We can find some fish there.
say:17:1421218016:1.female: Apologies, I've said too much... Oh, I know a small pond nearby. We can find some fish there.

choice:11:0:1.text: It's hard to imagine Feli as a mentor.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 难以想象斐利尔当老师的模样
choice:11:0:1.male: It's hard to imagine Feli as a mentor.
choice:11:0:1.female: It's hard to imagine Feli as a mentor.

choice:11:1:2.text: In my eyes, Feli was a child...
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 我一直把斐利尔当成小孩看待
choice:11:1:2.male: In my eyes, Feli was a child...
choice:11:1:2.female: In my eyes, Feli was a child...

say:19:1421218006:1.text: Well, they seem to like Liv more.
say:19:1421218006:1.source_cn: 嗯，它们看起来跟丽芙很亲近。

say:0:1421219001:0.text: Alright, we need some fresh tetra fish. Let's get started.
say:0:1421219001:0.source_cn: 要钓新鲜的盲泡鱼是吧？我们开始吧。
say:0:1421219001:0.male: Alright, we need some fresh tetra fish. Let's get started.
say:0:1421219001:0.female: Alright, we need some fresh tetra fish. Let's get started.

say:0:1421220001:0.text: I think that's enough. Let's go feed the monarch dragonflies.
say:0:1421220001:0.source_cn: 足够了，我们喂给大王蜻蜓吧。

say:1:1421221001:1.text: Wonderful! The monarch dragonflies seem lively again!
say:1:1421221001:1.source_cn: 太好了，大王蜻蜓恢复活力了！

say:2:1421221002:1.text: We need to check on the other small animals. Let's check on the blind mole rat.
say:2:1421221002:1.source_cn: 我们去看看别的小动物吧……去看看盲鼹吧！

say:1:1421222001:1.text: That's strange... The blind mole rat isn't in its cave but wandering around...
say:1:1421222001:1.source_cn: 好奇怪啊……盲鼹在附近徘徊，而不是在洞穴里。

choice_prompt:2:1421222001.text: That's strange... The blind mole rat isn't in its cave but wandering around...
choice_prompt:2:1421222001.source_cn: 好奇怪啊……盲鼹在附近徘徊，而不是在洞穴里。

say:3:1421222002:1.text: It's highly likely. Blind mole rats rely on sound to distinguish where to go. If no one guides them, they sometimes can't find their way home...
say:3:1421222002:1.source_cn: 确实！盲鼹靠声音辨别方向，如果没人指引，它们有时候会找...

say:4:1421222003:1.text: It does seem like this little critter couldn't find its way home.
say:4:1421222003:1.source_cn: 看样子，这个小家伙就是找不到自己的洞穴了。

say:5:1421222004:1.text: How did Feli guide it home before?
say:5:1421222004:1.source_cn: 斐利尔以前是怎么引导它的？

say:6:1421222005:1.text: Master Feli used to use bells and other instruments to guide lost animals.
say:6:1421222005:1.source_cn: 斐利尔大人会用铃铛、笛子或者其他乐器引导迷路的小动物们。

say:7:1421222006:1.text: He once said that soothing melodies would make them feel at ease.
say:7:1421222006:1.source_cn: 他曾经说过，舒缓的旋律能让它们感到安心。

choice_prompt:8:1421222006.text: He once said that soothing melodies would make them feel at ease.
choice_prompt:8:1421222006.source_cn: 他曾经说过，舒缓的旋律能让它们感到安心。

say:9:1421222007:1.text: Well, let's see if we can lure it out first.
say:9:1421222007:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们先去找到洞穴。待会就拜托你将它带过来了。

say:0:1421223001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, its home should be over there.
say:0:1421223001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, its home should be over there.
say:0:1421223001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, its home should be over there.

say:1:1421223002:0.text: Guide it slowly in that direction.
say:1:1421223002:0.source_cn: 慢慢引导它往这个方向吧。

say:0:1421224001:0.text: Oh, the blind mole rat moved! It knows that we're trying to guide it!
say:0:1421224001:0.source_cn: 盲鼹动了！它认出我们在引导了！

say:1:1421224002:0.text: We just can't guide it anywhere. We need to find its home.
say:1:1421224002:0.source_cn: 也不能漫无目的地引导，得同时寻找着它的家。

say:0:1421225101:0.text: Oh! Is that a flying squirrel?
say:0:1421225101:0.source_cn: 咦？突然出现了……一只小飞鼠？

say:1:1421225102:0.text: Yes, the flying squirrel keeps looking in that direction? Does it want us to follow?
say:1:1421225102:0.source_cn: 小飞鼠不停地向某个方向张望，是在示意我们跟上吗？
say:1:1421225102:0.male: Yes, the flying squirrel keeps looking in that direction? Does it want us to follow?
say:1:1421225102:0.female: Yes, the flying squirrel keeps looking in that direction? Does it want us to follow?

say:1:1421226001:0.text: The flying squirrel stopped. It's not leading us anymore.
say:1:1421226001:0.source_cn: 啊，小飞鼠停下了。它好像不继续带路了。

say:2:1421226002:1.text: Does it want us to... chase it?

say:3:1421226003:1.text: It's a possibility. Master Feli once told me that flying squirrels love playing hide-and-seek and racing games.
say:3:1421226003:1.source_cn: 有可能！斐利尔大人曾说过，小飞鼠特别喜欢玩捉迷藏和赛跑...

choice_prompt:4:1421226003.text: It's a possibility. Master Feli once told me that flying squirrels love playing hide-and-seek and racing games.
choice_prompt:4:1421226003.source_cn: 有可能！斐利尔大人曾说过，小飞鼠特别喜欢玩捉迷藏和赛跑的游戏。

say:5:1421226004:1.text: Well, we are talking about a flying squirrel in Master Feli's magical forest...
say:5:1421226004:1.source_cn: 但这是斐利尔大人的实验林地中的小飞鼠……

say:6:1421226005:1.text: Maybe it's part of his arrangement with the squirrel.
say:6:1421226005:1.source_cn: 说、说不定这也是他安排的一部分？

say:7:1421226006:1.text: Well, it's Feli we're talking about. He always came up with surprising ideas.
say:7:1421226006:1.source_cn: 确实可能，斐利尔确实总有些出人意料的点子.

say:8:1421226007:1.text: I believe you two should try playing with it. Master Feli may have arranged for this to happen.
say:8:1421226007:1.source_cn: 两位大人，我觉得我们应该陪它玩！斐利尔大人的安排一定有...
say:8:1421226007:1.male: I believe you two should try playing with it. Master Feli may have arranged for this to happen.
say:8:1421226007:1.female: I believe you two should try playing with it. Master Feli may have arranged for this to happen.

choice_prompt:10:1421226007.text: I believe you two should try playing with it. Master Feli may have arranged for this to happen.
choice_prompt:10:1421226007.source_cn: 两位大人，我觉得我们应该陪它玩！斐利尔大人的安排一定有他的用意。
choice_prompt:10:1421226007.male: I believe you two should try playing with it. Master Feli may have arranged for this to happen.
choice_prompt:10:1421226007.female: I believe you two should try playing with it. Master Feli may have arranged for this to happen.

choice:4:0:1.text: You sure? It wants to play now?
choice:4:0:1.male: You sure? It wants to play now?
choice:4:0:1.female: You sure? It wants to play now?

say:1:1421227001:1.text: Whoa! There are so many flying squirrels...

say:2:1421227002:1.text: They formed a circle but left a few empty spaces... Is this an invitation?
say:2:1421227002:1.source_cn: 它们围成一圈，但留了空位。是在邀请我们吗？

say:3:1421227003:1.text: Looks like rules to a game...
say:3:1421227003:1.source_cn: 看起来像某种游戏的规则。

say:4:1421227004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Master Indris, should we join in?
say:4:1421227004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Master Indris, should we join in?
say:4:1421227004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Master Indris, should we join in?

choice_prompt:5:1421227004.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Master Indris, should we join in?
choice_prompt:5:1421227004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人，因度厄大人，我们可以加入吗？
choice_prompt:5:1421227004.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Master Indris, should we join in?
choice_prompt:5:1421227004.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Master Indris, should we join in?

say:7:1421227007:1.text: Even though Feli is gone, they still remember the joy of playing with people.
say:7:1421227007:1.source_cn: 我总感觉……即使斐利尔不在了，但它们还记得和人类一起玩...

say:9:1421227006:1.text: Let's go for it. After all, they reserved a spot for us.
say:9:1421227006:1.source_cn: 试试吧，毕竟是特意留出的位置。

say:0:1421229001:0.text: This isn't an ordinary flower. It seems to contain a memory...
say:0:1421229001:0.source_cn: 这不是普通的花，里面好像蕴藏了一段回忆。
say:0:1421229001:0.male: This isn't an ordinary flower. It seems to contain a memory...
say:0:1421229001:0.female: This isn't an ordinary flower. It seems to contain a memory...

say:1:1421229002:0.text: Let me try to retrieve it.
say:1:1421229002:0.source_cn: 我试试能不能释放出来。
say:1:1421229002:0.male: Let me try to retrieve it.
say:1:1421229002:0.female: Let me try to retrieve it.

say:1:1421230001:0.text: Testing, one, two, three... Can anyone see this message?
say:1:1421230001:0.source_cn: 咳咳，有人能看到这段留言吗？测试，测试……

say:2:1421230002:1.text: It's my first time recording this. It should be okay.
say:2:1421230002:1.source_cn: 这是我第一次试录，应该没问题吧？

say:3:1421230003:1.text: I should have more confidence in my magic.
say:3:1421230003:1.source_cn: 唔，我得对自己的水平有点信心！斐利尔肯定没问题！

say:4:1421230004:1.text: Ah! Did I just record all of that? How do I delete this part?
say:4:1421230004:1.source_cn: 哇，我刚刚说的那段是不是被记录下来了……糟糕，怎么删除啊！

say:5:1421230005:1.text: Oh, never mind. I can't guarantee that anyone find this anyway. I need to get down to business.
say:5:1421230005:1.source_cn: 算了算了，也不一定有人看，先就这样吧！下面开始说正事——

say:6:1421230006:1.text: Hello, if you're seeing this, it means that you've found my experimental forest.
say:6:1421230006:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，如果你们看到这个，说明已经找到我的实验林地啦！

say:7:1421230007:1.text: It's beautiful, isn't it? I've put a lot of thought into this place.
say:7:1421230007:1.source_cn: 那里是不是很漂亮？我可是花了好多心思呢。

say:8:1421230008:1.text: To reward you for discovering it, I've prepared some gifts.
say:8:1421230008:1.source_cn: 为了奖励你们的发现，我要送你们一些礼物！

say:9:1421230009:1.text: Listen up. I've hidden some special items in a very secret place.
say:9:1421230009:1.source_cn: 听好啦！我在一个特别特别隐秘的地方藏了一些宝物——

say:16:1421230014:1.text: He was always a child in my eyes...

say:20:1421230017:1.text: Yes, I want to see what kind of puzzle he prepared for us.
say:20:1421230017:1.source_cn: 嗯，看看他给我们准备了什么样的谜题。

say:21:1421230019:1.text: W-we must find Master Feli's treasure.
say:21:1421230019:1.source_cn: 我、我们一定要找到……斐利尔大人的宝物……

document:0:178:0.text:
The experiment is almost complete, but it's not perfect yet...
Be that as it may, I haven't come up with any new ideas lately. Guess I just have to put the experiment on hold for now.
Lately, I keep having dreams about my forest being discovered by others... Instead of fearing it...
Why not prepare for it in advance and leave some rewards for whoever finds it?
Hmm, what kind of rewards should I prepare? And how do I give them hints?

All set! Here's my plan for now: the flying squirrel will be the guide, while the hopping mushroom sprites will show the correct directions...
It's both mysterious and fun!
Firstly, I need to come up with a chant that summons the hopping mushroom sprites...
<style="highlight">"Mushroom sprite! Hopping is alright!"</style> This sounds good!
My design's so cool! This way, if I ever forget the location, I'll be able to find the forest again!
I'm the youngest high priest in Sal'thorin, after all!
<align="right">By Feli</align>
document:0:178:0.source_cn:
实验进行的差不多了，但还不够完美……
不过我最近也没更多思路了，先暂缓一下吧！
最近老是做梦梦到林地被人发现……既然如此——
不如顺其自然，给发现林地的人小奖励！
唔，奖励什么呢？怎么提示呢？

（中间空白了好长一段）

全部搞定！目前的方案就是让小飞鼠带路，再找蹦蹦菇灵指引方向……
既有保密性，又有趣！
唔，我得先给蹦蹦菇灵设计一个召唤咒语……
就这个啦——<style="highlight">菇灵菇灵快快来！蹦！</style>
感觉这个设计超棒的！这样就算我忘记位置，也能找到宝物啦！
不愧是我，萨洛克兰最年轻的高级祭司！
<align="right">——斐利尔</align>
